Title: Azure HPC Cache now generally available in Germany West Central and US West 3

Body.Content:
Announcing the availability of Azure HPC Cache into two new regions, Germany West Central and US West 3.

Helping customers with the need for low-latency access to unstructured data to support high-performance computing (HPC) workloads, Azure HPC Cache has expanded availability into more regions. Customers running HPC workloads in Germany West Central or in US West 3 can now add this service via the Azure portal.

See a full list of geographies for Azure HPC Cache.

Explore how to get started HPC Cache in the supporting documentation.
